title: Old Debts
summary: Brannoc owes the Redhand's sergeants nothing, and they think he owes them a great deal. He'd like that settled before it follows him out of the Keep.

steps.journal: Put down three Redhand sergeants in Wickham Keep. They lead every fifth wave; Brannoc knows them by their shouting.

ready: Talk to Brannoc (tap his card, then Talk).
done: Three sergeants who kept his chain oiled. He didn't say anything when they fell. He did stand up straighter.
